target.title: [AI-assisted] fix(android): polish Voice text truncation
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves The Android Voice screen has several one-line status, mode, and setup labels inside constrained containers. On narrower screens or larger font scales, the Talk and Dictation rows can hard-clip text instead of truncating cleanly, which makes the Voice/Talk setup area feel visually rough. ## Why This Change Was Made This keeps the polish pass focused on the Voice screen by adding explicit width and overflow handling to the Voice status row, the Talk/Dictation mode row labels, and the Voice setup provider card text. The change only adjusts Compose layout/text behavior; it does not change voice capture, gateway readiness, Talk mode runtime behavior, or provider configuration. ## User Impact Users get a cleaner Voice/Talk screen in constrained layouts, especially with larger accessibility font settings. Long status and setup text now truncates with an ellipsis instead of being visually cut off, while the existing Voice screen structure and controls stay the same. ## Evidence - `./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assemblePlayDebug` on the baseline Android app: PASS. - `./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assemblePlayDebug` after the patch: PASS. - `./gradlew --no-daemon :app:runKtlintCheckOverMainSourceSet`: PASS. - `./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest`: PASS. - Real visual proof on an Android API 36 emulator using the Voice tab at 720x1600, density 420, and font scale 1.30: before the patch, Voice mode subtitles were hard-clipped; after the patch, the same text truncates with an ellipsis. Before: After: After video: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e1f716f-8843-43d9-8cc5-3a3d29d79309
